services.name: Museum Tours
services.desc: MacBride Museum is open all year long, offering tours and educational programs by appointment. These unique educational experiences and programs are a fun way to engage students in exploring the Yukon’s environment and amazing history. All programs are a $100 flat fee/class and programs run 60 minutes in length unless otherwise indicated or requested. We prefer programs to start at 10am or 1pm, however accommodations can be requested and may be granted depending on staff availability. blurb: Yukon's first - and recently expanded - museum offers a comprehensive view of the resilient people and groundbreaking events that have shaped the territory's history. Our galleries house over 40,000 objects that illustrate stories from Yukon First Nations, the natural world, the Klondike Gold Rush and more.
